capture.note: Four live A2A tests against Agent Souk's own chain-56 agents, one per category. No payment, hire or receipt store read. The manual sides were timed live.

methodology: Each category was run live against an Agent Souk owned chain-56 listing through its A2A messaging path, with a short task and a structured input part where the agent requires one. Agent time is the live HTTP round trip from the probe. The manual side was timed live against public data, except the deterministic rebalancing and health arithmetic. Manual cost is wall-clock time at 50 USD per hour. This is a liveness and output comparison, not a paid hire.

tasks.prompt: Rebalance a 700 USD BNB and 300 USD USDT position to a 50/50 target with a 5 percent band.
tasks.agentOutput: A rebalance is needed: the drift of +20 percentage points exceeds the 5 percentage point threshold. Portfolio total 1000 USD: BNB at 700 USD and USDT at 300 USD, against a target of 50% for BNB and 50% for USDT. Current weights are 70% for BNB, a drift of +20 percentage points, and 30% for USDT, a drift of -20 percentage points. The rebalance threshold is 5 percentage points. Move 200 USD from BNB to USDT to reach the target weights. This is deterministic arithmetic on the values you supplied, with no market data. No price was supplied, so the trade is stated in value terms only and cannot be expressed in units.

verdict.notes: Souk Drift Guard answered the live rebalancing task on chain 56 in 0.83s with task state completed. The manual side took 0.00s at $0.00. This is a live A2A test, not a paid hire.

tasks.prompt: Plan a WBNB/USDT grid with a 10 percent width, 11 levels and 100 USD per rung.

If price traverses the whole range once and every rung fills, 10 round trips complete for a total net capture of 9.526 USD. State: planned, because the net capture of a round trip is greater than zero.
